		severity = 100
		arch_context = "x86, arm64"

		$func1 = "vl_stealth"
		$func2 = "g_data"

		$func5 = "chk_port"
		$func6 = "mod_hide"

		$ebpf1 = "hidden_ports"
		$ebpf2 = "recvmsg_ctx"
		$ebpf3 = "SOCK_DIAG_BY_FAMILY"

	condition:
		(2 of ( $mod* ) and 3 of ( $func* ) ) or ( 1 of ( $mod* ) and 2 of ( $ebpf* ) ) or ( 4 of ( $func* ) )
